missing-snapshot.ttl.resultMessage: A RebuildAssessment must reference exactly one assessedAgainstSnapshot.

two-fidelity.ttl.resultMessage: rebuildFidelity must be a concept from RebuildFidelityScheme.

lineage-confirmed-twice.ttl.resultMessage: A RebuildAssessment must have exactly one lineageConfirmed boolean.

drift-without-baseline.ttl.resultMessage: rebuildDrift present requires a comparedAgainst baseline.

matched-without-baseline.ttl.resultMessage: A matched fidelity (exact/vendor-patched/modular-equivalent) requires a fidelityBaseline.

counterpart-false-with-fidelity.ttl.resultMessage: hasUpstreamCounterpart=false forbids fidelity, drift, baselines, and ambiguous candidates.

counterpart-true-missing-results.ttl.resultMessage: hasUpstreamCounterpart=true requires exactly one rebuildFidelity and one rebuildDrift.

self-baseline.ttl.resultMessage: A package must not be its own fidelity or drift baseline.

one-ambiguous.ttl.resultMessage: ambiguousCandidate requires at least two distinct candidates.

ambiguous-bad-confidence.ttl.resultMessage: An ambiguous assessment must have assessmentConfidence 0.5 and lineageConfirmed=false.

confirmed-unknown.ttl.resultMessage: lineageConfirmed=true requires a matched fidelity, a fidelityBaseline, and non-empty lineageEvidence.

confirmed-no-evidence.ttl.resultMessage: lineageConfirmed=true requires a matched fidelity, a fidelityBaseline, and non-empty lineageEvidence.

lineage-wrong-target.ttl.resultMessage: rebuildOf requires an assessment of the same package with the same fidelityBaseline and lineageConfirmed=true.

lineage-unconfirmed.ttl.resultMessage: rebuildOf requires an assessment of the same package with the same fidelityBaseline and lineageConfirmed=true.
